claims.claim: fallen wood in front of camps at 0.1 of an undeveloped shore's (Christensen et al. 1996: cabin sites 57 vs 555 logs/km)
claims.note: 57/555 = 0.103 compares cabin sites in developed lakes with the mean of undeveloped lakes. Within developed lakes, cabin sites against forested sites is 57/379 = 0.150 — exactly the 0.15 the model uses ('a project estimate between Christensen's 0.1 and Merrell's 0.38'), so the 0.15 could be cited to Christensen's within-lake contrast if the full text bears it out
